name: Ojai Valley Inn & Spa
insider_take: This legendary resort sits in California's mystical Ojai Valley, known for its "pink moment" sunsets and spiritual energy that has attracted celebrities and wellness seekers since 1923.
whats_special: The resort features a championship golf course designed by George C. Thomas Jr., the same architect behind Riviera Country Club. The property spans 220 acres of olive groves and oak trees, with the historic Libbey Bowl outdoor amphitheater just minutes away where the Ojai Music Festival takes place annually.
pro_tip: Visit the valley around sunset to witness the famous "pink moment" - a natural phenomenon where the mountains glow rose-colored for just a few minutes as the sun sets behind the Topa Topa range.
dont_miss: The Sunday Farmer's Market in downtown Ojai and a visit to Meditation Mount for panoramic valley views. The resort's Spa Ojai offers treatments inspired by the Chumash Native American traditions of the area.
pros: World-class spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Championship golf course with stunning mountain views
Multiple dining venues featuring farm-to-table cuisine
Beautiful Spanish Colonial architecture and landscaping
cons: Remote location requires driving to nearby attractions
Premium pricing for luxury resort amenities
